name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
steps: Assume a straight high-plank position on the floor with your hands placed noticeably wider than shoulder-width and your body aligned from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes firmly to prevent your hips from sagging.
Bend your elbows smoothly outward and slightly back to lower your chest toward the floor until you feel a controlled chest stretch.
Press firmly through your palms to extend your arms back to the starting plank position.
tips: Turn your fingers slightly outward if needed so your wrists and shoulders feel comfortable in the wide stance.
Keep your elbows slightly below shoulder level rather than flaring straight toward your ears.
